literal: Evening? not-you; united-ones' life consuming time you, bless-you, time!
translation: You are not merely the evening; you are the deadly hour that consumes the lives of those parted from their lovers. Oh time, may you live long!
modern: நீ வெறும் மாலைப்பொழுது இல்லை; காதலரை விட்டுப் பிரிந்தவர்களின் உயிரை உண்ணும் நேரம் நீ. பொழுதே, நீ வாழ்வாயாக!
explanation: The speaker addresses the evening directly, expressing the intense pain of separation. She says it is no longer just a normal evening, but a deadly time that consumes the lives of those parted from their lovers. The word 'வாழி' (may you live) is used ironically or in distress, highlighting her helplessness against the overwhelming sorrow brought by the time of day.
